issues.title: ZeroDivisionError on empty input
issues.detail: len([]) is 0, so sum([]) / len([]) raises ZeroDivisionError instead of ValueError.

issues.title: len() is not defined for generators
issues.detail: The request requires generators; len(generator) raises TypeError, and sum() would consume the generator first.

issues.title: No type hints or documented exceptions
issues.detail: The contract (accepted inputs, raised errors) is not visible to callers.

recommendations: Materialise the iterable once (list(numbers)) before computing sum and length.
Raise ValueError with a clear message when there are no values.
Add type hints and document the raised exception.
